title: Signal Over Noise
voiceover_full: You're not exhausted from doing too much. You're exhausted from absorbing too much noise. Most alerts, opinions, and headlines don't matter. The signal is the rare truth that moves your needle. Cut ninety percent of your inputs, and watch your output multiply. Protect your focus.
